lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Hey, Partner.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I was wondering...
What is it?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: What do you think is the best time to ride a bike?
Dawn.
Midday.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Dawn?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The sky begins to light up,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: as you feel the cool breeze on your face.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: But everyone's still sleeping at that point,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: so it might be too early

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: to really rev Black Typhoon's engine.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Midday?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Nothing beats going for a great ride while feeling the sun on your back,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: but everyone is out and about by then.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Even if the roads are wide, the streets are filled with numerous pedestrians,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: so you can't let loose while you ride.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: After all, you wouldn't want to be crashing into people.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Hmm...
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I had some business

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: in the Ark a few days ago.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: There I was, riding and minding my own business,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: but everyone was giving me grief.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If it's during the day, people say it's too dangerous.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If it's during the night, people say it's too noisy.
So you weren't able to ride your bike?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I didn't pay them any mind, and kept on riding.
What is that?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That's why I wanted to ask you

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: what's the best time to ride.
I see.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'm starting to like this place.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: There are fewer people, and

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: no one will complain as long as

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I stay away from the residential areas at night.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If I ride my bike here, I can do it whenever I wish to without worrying about anything.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Having said that, fancy going on a ride together later?
Sounds good.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Cool, then I'll be in touch.
